caseNameFull: Ralston v. Cox, U. S. Marshal
attorneys: Mr. J. Frank Kemp for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Mr. Oscar A. Provost for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied.
